title: Flat minimal tori and Lu's second-gap conjecture
summary: Lu conjectured that, for each dimension and codimension, there exists a positive gap above the first pinching value for the quantity $S+λ_2$ on closed minimal submanifolds of the unit sphere, where $S$ is the squared norm of the second fundamental form and $λ_2$ is the second eigenvalue of Lu's fundamental matrix. We disprove this second-gap conjecture for minimal surfaces in every codimension $q\ge3$. More precisely, in every odd codimension $q\ge3$ we construct linearly full closed embedded flat minimal tori with $S\equiv2$ for which the constant values of $S+λ_2$ are dense in $(2,3)$.…
